# Real Luxury Media

> Real Luxury Media is a Sarasota-based, done-for-you content company for established business owners, founders, experts, and real estate professionals. The team plans, films, and edits content around the person behind the business.

## Canonical information

- Business: Real Luxury Media
- Location: Sarasota, Florida
- Service area: Florida and selected projects across the United States
- Primary service: Done-for-you content creation and video production
- Contact: jake@realluxurymedia.com
- Website: https://realluxurymedia.com/

## Primary pages

- [Content creation service](https://realluxurymedia.com/services/content-creation/): What the team handles and how a project works.
- [Done-for-you content guide](https://realluxurymedia.com/resources/done-for-you-content-creation/): Definition, process, client time, fit, cost factors, and limitations.
- [Sarasota content creation](https://realluxurymedia.com/sarasota-content-creation/): Local context, service area, and production approach.
- [Content for realtors](https://realluxurymedia.com/realtors/): The content system for established real estate professionals.
- [Roger Pettingell project](https://realluxurymedia.com/work/roger-pettingell/): A documented client project with film and public-channel links.
- [About Real Luxury Media](https://realluxurymedia.com/about/): Company approach and Jake Pettingell's background.
- [Contact](https://realluxurymedia.com/contact/): How to enquire about a project.

## Editorial principles

- Connection comes before production.
- Content should turn real expertise, experience, opinions, and personality into material people understand and care about.
- Real Luxury Media does not guarantee a specific number of views, followers, leads, or sales.
- Project outcomes depend on the offer, audience, distribution, market, and follow-through.

This file is a concise reference. The linked HTML pages are the canonical sources.
